The travel fill cue borrows from design-coded bullet lists and the modern journey-marker aesthetic, which is exactly why the emoji reads as travel coded rather than literal railway-car-coded shape.

In real-world usage 🚃 lives in the spaces where the sender wants to communicate journey-marker energy. A partner sends it on a 'travel 🚃' journey-marker marker. The travel fill cue is what makes the emoji feel travel coded — it is not just 'shape,' it is 'travel coded railway-car moment.'

That is why 🚃 travels especially well on partner journey-marker markers, journey-marker reveals, and any context where the sender wants the message to land with travel energy.
